Microphone permission lets virtual machine apps record audio or make voice calls. Audio captured by the phone’s microphone is shared with virtual machines using this mapping.

Precise-location and phone-state permissions share cell identifiers, network types and signal strengths readable by the phone with virtual machines using this mapping. Phone baseband control is not exposed.

Bluetooth scan and connect permissions share nearby Bluetooth device names, addresses, types and signal strengths with virtual machines using this mapping. The phone’s pairing keys are not shared.
